<!--
A column spanner is CENTRED over the columns it covers. This fixture
carries BOTH spanning shapes on purpose, because the filter that centres
spanners must not touch the other one:

  * tbl-twoway  -- a two-way table, whose HEAD rows carry spanners
                   (`alcohol` over three level labels, each over M and SD);
  * tbl-blocks  -- a blocks regression, whose BODY carries row-group labels
                   ("Model 1", "Model 2") that span every column and are
                   FLUSH LEFT.

Both are `col_span > 1`. Only the head ones may be centred. A fixture with
only the two-way table would let a filter that centred every spanning cell
pass, while silently centring row-group labels in every grouped table --
which is why both are here.
-->

```{r}
#| include: false
library(apaTables)
twoway_tbl <- apa.2way.table(iv1 = gender, iv2 = alcohol, dv = attractiveness,
                             data = goggles, table.number = 1)
blkA <- lm(sales ~ adverts + airplay, data = album)
blkB <- lm(sales ~ adverts + airplay + I(adverts + airplay), data = album)
blocks_tbl <- apa.reg.table(blkA, blkB, table.number = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-twoway
#| message: false
#| warning: true
apa.quarto.html(twoway_tbl)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-blocks
#| message: false
#| warning: true
apa.quarto.html(blocks_tbl)
```
